_about: The one pinned table of the runtime layer's way 'fetch' (orchestrator/Core/runtime_layer.py PREBUILT): per tool and architecture the URL and the sha256 of every prebuilt static program it may fetch. kind 'deb': a Debian package (archive_sha256 of the package, member and sha256 of the program in it); kind 'file': the program itself (sha256). busybox comes from Debian's busybox-static on snapshot.debian.org. Debian ships no static setpriv; its proposed source is a release asset of this project, built by the project's own CI (job 'Runtime layer tools' in .github/workflows/ci.yml, which uploads the programs with their SHA256SUMS as workflow artifacts). Until the maintainer publishes such a release and its URL and sha256 are entered here, setpriv has no entry and the way 'fetch' refuses, naming the way 'build'.
